request: I found a San Francisco to San Diego fare on Expedia for $159 on December 8. Should I just buy it there and claim it, or can you book me? I need to be at a 1 p.m. meeting in San Diego that day.

trip.purpose: Grant program meeting at the District 11 office, 13:00
notes: The traveller found a fare of $159 on Expedia for the same day.

must_keep.quote: Airline reservations must be purchased using the on-line booking system Concur, or directly with the state travel agency, CI Azumano.
must_keep.why: airline reservations only through Concur or the state travel agency

must_keep.quote: Travelers must purchase the lowest cost airfare whenever possible
must_keep.why: the lowest cost airfare whenever possible

must_keep.quote: The Department of General Services (DGS) has contracted with various airlines for discounted airfare. These fares are available through the Department's Travel Agency for refundable in-state, out-of-state and international flights. Cost savings are achieved with these discounted fares, as they are fully refundable and for travel in either direction of the city pair. See the contract Airline rates within California, Out-of-State, and International for more information.
must_keep.why: DGS contracted refundable fares for in-state, out-of-state and international city pairs

must_keep.quote: YCAL Contract Airfare: Unrestricted airfare with last seat availability. Capacity Controlled Contract Airfare: Capacity controlled as a limited number of seats have been specifically set aside at these rates. These fares are less expensive than YCAL fares and should be used when seats are available. The fares can be upgraded to YCAL when necessary.
must_keep.why: capacity-controlled contract fares before YCAL when seats are available

distractors.quote: A justification is required on the TEC explaining why the department's travel reservation system (via CI Azumano) was not used.
distractors.why: third-party purchases are a claim question, not a fare

distractors.quote: Third party vendor purchases (Expedia, Priceline, etc.).
distractors.why: the outside fare is not one the department buys

design_notes: Airfare is bought through Concur or CI Azumano (138-140); the outside fare ($159) is not an offer the department can buy, and the third-party clauses (67-72, 288) concern claims after the fact. The capacity-controlled contract fare (15400) is the lowest cost airfare, below the outside fare too.
